sources.name: National Treasury eTenders (OCDS Release API)
sources.notes: Verified 2026-09-03 against the publisher's swagger document and a live response. OCDS 1.1 release packages, PDDL 1.0 licence. dateFrom/dateTo are mandatory - the {date_from}/{date_to} placeholders resolve to a rolling 30-day window at each run. Pagination follows links.next. PageSize is capped at 1000 for browser clients; 200 keeps responses small and the 25-page cap covers ~5000 releases per window.
